::: {.prose}

Questions, bug reports, ideas for a new feature, or a possible collaboration: this page points each of them to the right place.

:::

## General Support

For questions, bug reports, or feature requests, start with one of these:

```{=html}
<div class="contact-routes">

  <a class="contact-route" href="intro.html">
    <span class="contact-route-title">Check the documentation</span>
    <span class="contact-route-desc">Guides and common solutions for every module of the suite.</span>
    <span class="contact-route-go">Browse docs <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="contact-route" href="https://github.com/lrncrd/PyPottery/issues" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
    <span class="contact-route-title">Report an issue</span>
    <span class="contact-route-desc">Submit a bug report, or check whether someone has already raised it.</span>
    <span class="contact-route-go">View issues <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right"></i></span>
  </a>

  <a class="contact-route" href="https://github.com/lrncrd/PyPottery/issues/new" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
    <span class="contact-route-title">Request a feature</span>
    <span class="contact-route-desc">Suggest a new feature or an improvement through the GitHub issue tracker.</span>
    <span class="contact-route-go">Open a request <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right"></i></span>
  </a>

</div>
```
